info.title: Noosphere
info.description: Application landscape API: applications, flows, data objects, teams, domains and documentation pages, with change proposals and revision history. Guide: docs/en/api.md.

requestBody.description: An exchange file, in JSON or YAML.

owningTeamId.description: Team whose members publish changes; null when only administrators do.

mentionedIn.description: Pages whose body links to the record.

sourceOf.description: Ids of the data objects whose source is this application (derived from `DataObject.sourceApplicationId`).

completeness.description: Share of the recommended fields that are filled, 0 to 1.

ApplicationDetailDto.description: An application with its owner, the reader's permissions and its pages.

sourceOf.description: Ids of the data objects whose source is this application (derived from `DataObject.sourceApplicationId`).

completeness.description: Share of the recommended fields that are filled, 0 to 1.

ApplicationDto.description: An application the reader may see in full. `restricted` is always false (true on RestrictedApplicationDto).

ApplicationKind.description: What an application is: an application proper, a message bus, a SaaS, a data store, a file exchange or a third party.

owningTeamId.description: Team whose members publish changes; null when only administrators do.

mentionedIn.description: Pages whose body links to the record.

DataObjectDetailDto.description: A data object with its owner (the team of its source application), permissions and pages.

oneOf.description: Value before (null when empty or on a creation).
Value after (null when empty or on a deletion).

beforeTitle.description: For `ref` fields: the name of the record referred to.

DiffEntryDto.description: One changed field. `markdown` fields carry the raw texts, for an inline word diff.

owningTeamId.description: Team whose members publish changes; null when only administrators do.

mentionedIn.description: Pages whose body links to the record.

DomainDetailDto.description: A domain (administrators only change it) with its pages.

mode.description: Always `full`: the file describes the whole landscape it was exported from.

owningTeamId.description: Team whose members publish changes; null when only administrators do.

mentionedIn.description: Pages whose body links to the record.

sensitivity.description: Most sensitive of the carried data objects (internal when there is none).

FlowDetailDto.description: A flow with its owner (its owner team, or else the team of its source application), permissions and pages.

sensitivity.description: Most sensitive of the carried data objects (internal when there is none).

FlowDto.description: A flow the reader may see in full. `restricted` is always false (true on RestrictedFlowDto).

oneOf.description: Null for revisions made by the system (migration, command line).

HistoryEntryDto.description: One revision of a record, newest first.

index.description: Position of the item in `items`, or null for an error on the envelope.

path.description: JSON path of the faulty value, e.g. `items[3].spec.fromId`.

applied.description: True when the changes were written (not a dry run, no error).

ImportResultDto.description: Outcome of an import (or of its dry run): counts of items, or the errors that stopped it (nothing written).

toValidate.description: Submitted proposals the reader may accept or refuse.

mineOpen.description: The reader's own proposals in draft or submitted.

LandscapeDto.description:
Everything the explorer needs, in one call. `applications` holds ApplicationDto or
RestrictedApplicationDto items, `flows` holds FlowDto or RestrictedFlowDto items
(discriminated by `restricted`).

LandscapeStatsDto.description: Counts of what the landscape response holds.

links.description: Wiki links of the body, resolved; `exists: false` marks a broken link.

backlinks.description: Pages whose body links to this page.

ancestors.description: From the top-level page down to the parent.

attachedTitle.description: Name of the attached record (null when missing or hidden).

owningTeamId.description: Team whose members publish changes; null when only administrators do.

parentId.description: Parent page in the tree; null for a top-level page.

order.description: Position among its siblings (ascending, then by title).

ownerTeamId.description: Owning team as set on the page; when null, the owner of the attached record owns it.

PageDetailDto.description: A page with its resolved links, backlinks, place in the tree, owner and the reader's permissions.

parentId.description: Parent page in the tree; null for a top-level page.

order.description: Position among its siblings (ascending, then by title).

ownerTeamId.description: Owning team as set on the page; when null, the owner of the attached record owns it.

PageDto.description: A documentation page the reader may see in full. `restricted` is always false.

ownerTeamId.description: Optional: when empty, the owner of the attached record owns the page (administrators when none).

title.description: Name of the target; null when it does not exist or is hidden from the reader.

restricted.description: The target exists but the reader may not see it.

PageLinkDto.description: A link found in a page body.

parentId.description: New parent; null moves the page to the top level.

version.description: Optional: when given, a stale version returns 409.

PageRefDto.description: A page, as listed on a record or next to another page.

brokenLinks.description: Number of wiki links whose target does not exist.

PageSummaryDto.description: A page in the list (no body).

PageTreeNodeDto.description: A node of the page tree. A restricted page hidden from the reader has no title.

publish.description: Save, delete or restore directly (administrator, or member of the owning team).

propose.description: Send a change proposal (members and administrators, on applications, flows, data objects and pages).

PermissionsDto.description: What the signed-in user may do with a record.

errors.description: Field errors (field name in camelCase, then messages), on 400 only.

outdated.description: true on the 409 answered when accepting a proposal whose records changed since it was written.

targetTitle.description: Name of the target (after the change for a creation).

currentVersion.description: Version of the target now (null when it does not exist).

outdated.description: The target changed since `baseVersion`: accepting returns 409 until the proposal is rebased.

conflicts.description: Fields changed both by the proposal and on the record, found by the last rebase.

ProposalChangeDto.description: A change with its snapshots and field diff.

targetId.description: Record changed; null for a creation (the id then comes from `after.id` or the name).

baseVersion.description: Version the change was written against: required for update and delete.

oneOf.description: The whole record after the change, in the shape of its PUT body (create and update).

ownerTeams.description: Teams that validate (one validator each). An administrator accepts on behalf of all.

requiresAdmin.description: A target is owned by administrators only (no owning team): only an administrator accepts.

canDecide.description: The reader may accept or refuse it now.

canEdit.description: The reader is the author and may still edit, submit or withdraw it.

submit.description: true sends it for validation at once; otherwise it stays a draft.

version.description: On PUT: the proposal version that was read.

ProposalOwnerDto.description: An owning team whose acceptance the proposal needs.

publish.description: Save, delete or restore directly (administrator, or member of the owning team).

propose.description: Send a change proposal (members and administrators, on applications, flows, data objects and pages).

permissions.description: What the signed-in user may do with a record.

items.description: A page, as listed on a record or next to another page.
A page, as listed on a record or next to another page.

RecordContextDto.description: Owner, permissions and pages of a record.

RecordKind.description: Kinds of versioned records: each has a history of revisions.

reason.description: Shown to the author: 3 to 500 characters.

outcome.description: `published` (a new revision) or `proposed` (a submitted proposal, for non-owners).

RestrictedApplicationDto.description: A restricted application, as seen by a reader who is not an administrator.

RestrictedFlowDto.description: A flow from or to a restricted application, as seen by a reader who is not an administrator.

RestrictedPageDto.description: A restricted page, as seen by a reader who is not an administrator.

RevisionDto.description: A revision with its snapshot (the record's editable fields, in the shape of its PUT body).

subtitle.description: For a page: an excerpt of the body around the match.

Sensitivity.description: Ordered from the least to the most sensitive: the sensitivity of a flow is the maximum of what it carries.

instanceName.description: Shown in the header and the browser tab (default "Noosphere").

organisationName.description: Shown under the instance name; may be empty.

defaultLanguage.description: Language of new accounts and of the sign-in page: `en` or `fr`.

owningTeamId.description: Team whose members publish changes; null when only administrators do.

mentionedIn.description: Pages whose body links to the record.

TeamDetailDto.description: A team (administrators only change it) with its members and pages.

TeamMembersInput.description: Replaces the members of a team.

TrashItemDto.description: A deleted record. Its history is kept; administrators restore it.

UserRefDto.description: A user as shown next to a proposal or a revision.

password.description: New password; leave empty to keep the current one. Changing it closes the user's sessions.

teamIds.description: Teams of the user; null keeps them unchanged.

Visibility.description: `Restricted` applications are only shown in full to administrators; others see their id and domain.
